summary: The relief rally has broadened, with benchmarks up about 1% as buying spreads from tech into FMCG and healthcare, while metals and pharma lag.

detail.leaders: IT, FMCG; TCS, Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare
detail.tone: Stronger than at 10 am's note: at 10 am Sensex was 72,259.46 (+666.22, +0.93%) and Nifty 22,457.85 (+226.05, +1.02%); the latest headline has the Sensex up about 700 pts.

src.title: Business Standard: Stock Market LIVE – Sensex rises 700 pts, Nifty tops 22,450 as TCS, Apollo Hospitals shares lead

top.title: IT rallies despite US PERM suspension
top.line: All 10 Nifty IT stocks are up even as the US suspends PERM filings for eight IT firms
more: Nifty IT up 3.26% to 28,642.10 at 9:49 am; Wipro +3.3%, LTIMindtree +3.3%
Suspension covers TCS, Infosys, Wipro and HCL Tech
Analysts warn forced local hiring could pressure margins

src.title: Outlook Money: TCS, Infosys, Wipro gain despite US PERM scheme suspension

top.title: Hospital stocks rally up to 5%
top.line: Apollo, Max, Fortis and Yatharth gain on reports of a 30% trade-margin cap on cancer drugs
more: Centre reportedly capping trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP
Max Healthcare up about 2.3% and Apollo about 2.1%, both among top Nifty gainers

src.title: Business Standard: Hospital stocks – why have Fortis, Apollo, Max, Yatharth rallied up to 5%?

top.title: TCS extends gains, leads Nifty 50
top.line: Shares up about 4.7%, the top Nifty gainer as IT leads the rebound
more: Q2 net profit rose about 15% YoY to ₹13,884 cr
Deal wins (TCV) of $9.6 bn; margins flagged as weak
